name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: a panel for skills and connectors, and a progress bar and agents panel for sub-agent work.

plugins.name: skill-switchboard
plugins.description: One panel for your skills and connectors, each with a switch, a search, and a one-click install from your own skills library.

plugins.name: fun-savvy-progress
